candidates.title: Jerry Seinfeld: I'm Telling You for the Last Time
candidates.description: Months after his classic TV sitcom ends, the legendary comic returns to his stand-up roots to deliver his best jokes on a sold-out international tour.

candidates.title: Jerry Seinfeld: Comedian
candidates.cast: Jerry Seinfeld, Orny Adams, Colin Quinn, Bill Cosby, Robert Klein, Chris Rock, Garry Shandling, Jay Leno, Kevin Nealon, Ray Romano
candidates.description: Christian Charles's documentary follows established comedian Jerry Seinfeld and up-and-comer Orny Adams as they navigate the stand-up circuit.

candidates.title: Jeff Garlin: Our Man In Chicago
candidates.description: Comedian Jeff Garlin (unintentionally) celebrates his 37th year of stand-up and shares his learnings on love, loss, success and food addiction.

candidates.title: Chelsea Handler: Uganda Be Kidding Me Live
candidates.description: In her first Netflix stand-up comedy special, Chelsea Handler recounts her African adventures (and provides hilarious photographic evidence).

candidates.title: Jim Jefferies: This Is Me Now
candidates.description: The gleefully irreverent Jefferies skewers "grabby" celebrities, political hypocrisy and his own ill-advised career moves in a brash stand-up special.

candidates.title: Comedians in Cars Getting Coffee
candidates.listed_in: Stand-Up Comedy & Talk Shows, TV Comedies
candidates.description: Jerry Seinfeld's roving talk show combines coffee, laughs and vintage cars into quirky, caffeine-fueled adventures with the sharpest minds in comedy.

candidates.title: The Original Kings of Comedy
candidates.cast: Steve Harvey, D.L. Hughley, Cedric the Entertainer, Bernie Mac
candidates.description: Director Spike Lee documents the last night of the hit comedy tour featuring comics Steve Harvey, Cedric the Entertainer, D.L. Hughley and Bernie Mac.

candidates.title: The Comedy Lineup
candidates.listed_in: Stand-Up Comedy & Talk Shows, TV Comedies
candidates.cast: Michelle Buteau, Ian Karmel, Taylor Tomlinson, Sam Jay, Phil Wang, Sabrina Jalees, Jak Knight, Tim Dillon
candidates.description: A diverse group of up-and-coming comedians perform 15-minute sets in this stand-up comedy showcase series.

candidates.title: Judd Apatow: The Return
candidates.description: Judd Apatow returns to stand-up comedy after 25 years, riffing on living with three women, amusing moments from his career and much more.

candidates.title: Maria Bamford: The Special Special Special
candidates.cast: Maria Bamford, Wayne Federman, Jackie Kashian
candidates.description: Spend an evening with gleeful, oh-so-awkward Maria Bamford via her cozy, shot-at-home comedy special, which has a two-person audience: her parents.

candidates.title: Colin Quinn: The New York Story
candidates.description: The "SNL" veteran performs his off-Broadway show about the history of New York and the people who shape its personality. Directed by Jerry Seinfeld.

candidates.title: The Degenerates
candidates.listed_in: Stand-Up Comedy & Talk Shows, TV Comedies
candidates.cast: Big Jay Oakerson, Brad Williams, Yamaneika Saunders, Liza  Treyger, Joey Diaz, Christina Pazsitzky
candidates.description: Six stand-ups explore the coarse and salacious side of comedy in this series of half-hour specials. For mature audiences.

candidates.title: Joe Mande’s Award-Winning Comedy Special
candidates.description: Stand-up comic Joe Mande aims for critical adulation with this special that covers dating shows, "Shark Tank," Jewish summer camp and much more.

candidates.title: Seth Rogen's Hilarity for Charity
candidates.cast: Seth Rogen, Ike Barinholtz, Michael Che, Sacha Baron Cohen, Jeff Goldblum, Tiffany Haddish, Chris Hardwick, Nick Kroll, John Mulaney, Kumail Nanjiani, Chelsea Peretti, Craig Robinson & The Nasty Delicious, Lauren Miller Rogen, Justin Roiland, Sarah Silverman, Michelle Wolf
candidates.description: Seth Rogen and friends combine stand-up, sketches and music for an outrageous comedy special that could only come from the mind of Seth.

candidates.title: Mike Epps: Only One Mike
candidates.description: In a raw stand-up comedy special, Mike Epps mixes it up as he tackles sexual misconduct, special ed, aging body parts and much more.

candidates.title: Hari Kondabolu: Warn Your Relatives
candidates.description: Hari Kondabolu breaks down identity politics, celebrity encounters, his mango obsession and more in an unpredictable stand-up comedy special.

candidates.title: Stand Up and Away! with Brian Regan
candidates.listed_in: Stand-Up Comedy & Talk Shows, TV Comedies
candidates.description: Brian Regan blends his trademark observational stand-up with short sketches and a bit of audience interaction in this hybrid comedy series.

candidates.title: The Standups
candidates.listed_in: Stand-Up Comedy & Talk Shows, TV Comedies
candidates.cast: Nate Bargatze, Fortune Feimster, Deon Cole, Nikki Glaser, Beth Stelling, Dan Soder
candidates.description: Comedy's freshest voices take the stage in LA for six half-hour specials packed with sly jokes, hilarious anecdotes and awkward confessions.

candidates.title: Jeff Foxworthy and Larry the Cable Guy: We’ve Been Thinking...
candidates.cast: Jeff Foxworthy, Larry the Cable Guy
candidates.description: Grammy-nominated comedians Jeff Foxworthy and Larry the Cable Guy bring their distinctive brand of humor to a packed crowd in Minneapolis.

candidates.title: Tom and Jerry: The Magic Ring

candidates.description: When a young wizard leaves Tom to guard his priceless magic ring, Jerry gets the ring stuck on his head, igniting a series of slapstick antics.

candidates.title: Def Comedy Jam 25

candidates.title: Tom Segura: Completely Normal
candidates.description: Levelheaded stand-up Tom Segura shares offhand appraisals on hotels and opens up about his hobbies and digestive ailments in this comedy special.

candidates.title: Best of Stand-Up 2020

candidates.title: Jerry Seinfeld: 23 Hours To Kill

candidates.title: Jim Gaffigan: Cinco

candidates.title: Garfunkel and Oates: Trying to be Special

candidates.title: Dr. Seuss' The Grinch

candidates.description: A grump with a mean streak plots to bring Christmas to a halt in the cheerful town of Whoville. But a generous little girl could change his heart.
